entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I... I need to make a return. I ordered a jersey a while back and it just doesn't fit. I'm so disappointed.

I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference with the fit?

It's just the wrong size. I've been a loyal customer for years and I always get the same size, but this new jersey is just way too tight across the shoulders. I saved up for it and I just... I feel terrible that I can't even wear it.
I understand how frustrating that must be, especially when you were looking forward to it. Let me pull up your account to see what we can do. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I really needed that money back for the holidays, you know? It's just been a tough month.

Thank you for that. I see your account now, and I also see you're one of our VIP members. We really appreciate your loyalty. Okay, it looks like the jersey was delivered 62 days ago. That's perfectly within our 90-day return policy for standard apparel. I can absolutely approve this return for you.
Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried it had been too long. That's a huge relief.

Not a problem at all. We can process a full refund to your original payment method. Or, if you'd prefer, we could set up an exchange for the next size up. Since you're a valued member and this was our sizing inconsistency, I can process an exchange with complimentary expedited shipping to get the right one out to you immediately.
You can do that? An exchange would be wonderful! I really did love the design. Getting the right size sent out quickly would be amazing. Thank you so much, Alex!

It's my pleasure. I've just processed the exchange for one size larger. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid return label for the jersey that was too tight, and a confirmation for your new order momentarily. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. You've really turned my day around.
I'm happy I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
